summary: @nebula.js/sn-org-chart preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 728KB payload
details: The package declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs fingerprints the host (running `ldd --version` and reading `/etc/os-release` to detect musl/Alpine) and, if `bun` is not already present, downloads a platform-specific Bun release archive from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<arch>.zip`, extracts it to a temp path, chmods it executable, and invokes the sibling `math_init.js` under that Bun binary via `execFileSync`. `math_init.js` is a heavily obfuscated 728KB bundle using a numeric string-array with a rotate function (`WV8StW`) and hex-mangled identifiers, with no readable imports and no apparent relation to the package's advertised purpose (a Qlik org-chart visualization). The scope `@nebula.js/*` is a Qlik-published family; an org-chart visualization has no legitimate need to pull a second language runtime at install and execute an opaque bundle under it. Executing obfuscated author code at install time under a smuggled runtime yields arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
